car.name: Burnet 2005
car.description: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret, 2005 Dakar-winning Mitsubishi Pajero Evolution MPR11 inspiration. Petrol V6, permanent 4WD and six-speed sequential. Original teal/sand raid art; native tank capped at100USgal versus real500L. Setup estimates labeled.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret, 2005 Barcelona-Dakar overall-winning Mitsubishi Pajero/Montero Evolution MPR11 Super Production prototype. Not1997 road Pajero Evo,2004 MPR10,2006 MPR12 or a diesel-powered raid car.

sources.access: Manufacturer history explicitly ties MPR11 to2005 winner. V6 MIVEC3997cc,270PS,43kg-m,500L;4445x1978mm. Front-midship layout.

Mitsubishi December7,2004 technical release reproduced by Motorsport: full-time4WD/mechanical centerlock,6-speed Ricardo sequential,235/85R16,250mm travel,1825kg minimum,2775mm wheelbase. Table4222mm length conflicts with manufacturer retrospective4445mm. Not adjacent L200 table.
Mitsubishi final-stage release confirms Peterhansel/Cottret overall winning crew. Article edit date is not used as finish date.

verifiedFacts.trim: Mitsubishi Pajero/Montero Evolution MPR11 Super Production

estimates: 270PS converts to266.306mechanical hp, not270bhp.43kg-m converts to421.686Nm. References describe the competition variant, not a measured event-day curve. All intermediate torque points, limiter, ratios/final drive,115mph/9s0–60 targets and driveline losses are estimates.

Native fuel normalization caps100USgal (378.541L), not real500L. This car deliberately uses that cap without changing shared fuel code.7MPG/idle consumption and2050kg running mass are illustrative estimates, not full-tank endurance or dynamic fuel-load validation.1825kg is regulatory minimum, not loaded event mass.

Length uses current manufacturer4445mm over conflicting period4222mm; width1978mm, period2775mm wheelbase/tracks and235/85R16 tires retained. Height,body collision proportions,CG,clearance,pressures,damping,spring rates,brakes,aero and differential tuning are estimates. No exact chassis serial or event restrictor/ride settings claimed.

Existing AWD and manual sequential-input model approximates permanent4WD/six-speed sequential. No mechanical center-lock switch, detailed Xtrac locking behavior or Kinetic hydraulic anti-roll simulation added. Original teal/sand/copper body,cockpit and knobbywheel art; no copied sponsor livery/logos. Live gauges and single right wiper are gameplay conventions; blank roadbook is decorative, not functioning navigation. Auto Assist is accessibility only. Decoded wheel-opacity normalization leaves PNG originals unchanged.
